display_long_description:
The Wound Care Simulator from XR Guru immerses nurses and medical trainees in a realistic virtual environment to practice wound care techniques. Step-by-step guidance ensures users master the skills needed to clean, dress, and document wound care safely and effectively. 

With multi-language support (English, Spanish, French, and Arabic), this simulator ensures inclusivity and accessibility for a global audience.   

The experience is enhanced by an AI companion, acting as a virtual mentor, to answer questions to reinforce learning. 
 
# Key Features:  
 - Multi-Language Support: Tailored instructions and narrations in four major languages to cater to diverse learners.  
 - AI Companion: An interactive assistant that responds to user queries and provides clarifications to meet learning needs. (NOTE: Generative AI is still experimental) 

# Learning Objectives: 
- Understand proper wound cleaning and dressing techniques. 
- Apply best practices to prevent infection and promote healing. 
- Ensure patient comfort and safety during wound care procedures. 
- Document wound care procedures accurately for medical records. 

This VR training enhances confidence and proficiency in performing wound care in clinical settings.
